apps.name: Phyllanthus & Rattans Identification Kit
apps.summary: Identify Phyllanthus and rattans by the characters you can see, then read nomenclature, descriptions, uses, images, distribution and DNA barcodes.
apps.origin: Indian Barcode of Life kit (DBT, Government of India), 2010. Built by ATREE Bangalore, UAS Bangalore and BSI Kolkata.
apps.gis: Not needed. Locality coordinates can be exported to GIS from Version 2.

downloads.note: Adds Start-menu and desktop shortcuts. No administrator password.
Runs straight from a folder or pen drive.
Built by the GitHub build robot. Intel and Apple-silicon Macs.
Any computer. Extract, then double-click Open Kit.html.

changes.text: Faithful rebuild of the 2010 program. Same species, data and identification keys; results checked against the original database on 1,290 combinations.
